# Wake Up Wednesday

> A community guide from the Greater Hartford Branch NAACP. Plain-language information about your home, neighborhood, and life resources in Hartford, Connecticut.

Wake Up Wednesday helps Hartford residents see real data about their housing and neighborhood, understand what it means, and take action — from writing a landlord letter to building a 30-day stabilization plan.

## Pages

- [Home](/): See it, name it, fix it — the entry point to the guide.
- [Your Home](/home): Look up any Hartford address. See code violations, evictions, utility shutoffs, and 311 complaints in plain language.
- [Take action on your home](/home-actions): Concrete steps to improve your housing situation.
- [Your Neighborhood](/neighborhood): A report card for your block — air, schools, safety, access.
- [Take action for your neighborhood](/neighborhood-actions): Concrete actions based on the neighborhood data.
- [Your Path](/life): A short survey that builds a personal 30-day stabilization plan with real Connecticut resources.
- [Find help near me](/find-help): Vetted Connecticut organizations for housing, food, health, legal, and jobs.
- [Landlord complaint letter](/landlord-letter): Generate a formal habitability complaint letter citing Connecticut law.
- [Security deposit demand letter](/security-deposit-letter): Generate a written demand to recover your security deposit.
